title: Generative Adversarial Nets
summary: Ian J. Goodfellow, Jean Pouget-Abadie, Mehdi Mirza, Bing Xu, David Warde-Farley, Sherjil Ozair, Aaron Courville, and Yoshua Bengio submitted arXiv:1406.2661 on June 10, 2014. The paper proposes an adversarial framework for estimating generative models by training a generative model G and a discriminative model D in a two-player minimax game.
significance: A documented 2014 research milestone introducing the adversarial generative-modeling framework described in the original paper and later published in the NeurIPS 2014 proceedings.
